_approach: A genuinely triplet-grid construction: the halfstep frame (kick on 1, snare on 3) stays intact, but a conga cross-rhythm lands every third 16th step (a common triplet-over-16 shorthand) while the library's heaviest documented swing (0.25) pushes the whole grid toward a true shuffle feel. Ref: Studio Brootle 'Dubstep Drum Patterns' (swung 16ths at 64–75%, triplet-grid tips).
